_general_note: Most prerequisites in this department are non-academic (audition, participation, prior experience) rather than course-based, and generally cannot be validated by the tool the way 'completed Algebra I' can. Modeled as 'requirement' notes (display-only) rather than gate-able course links, per our earlier discussion.

courses.title: Beginning Band - Concert Band
special_notes: Small per-semester fee to band boosters
courses.description: A beginner-level, performance-based ensemble for brass and woodwind students, learning the fundamentals of musicianship and developing good ensemble playing techniques. After-school commitments include band concerts, contests, and rehearsals leading up to performances; attendance is mandatory. Students should consider a step-up instrument. Small per-semester fee to band boosters.

courses.title: Intermediate Band - Symphonic Band
courses.description: An intermediate-level, performance-based ensemble for brass, woodwind, and percussion students, refining musicianship fundamentals and developing advanced ensemble playing techniques. After-school commitments include concerts, contests, and rehearsals; attendance mandatory. Small per-semester fee to band boosters.

courses.title: Intermediate Band - Wind Symphony
courses.description: An intermediate-level, performance-based ensemble for brass, woodwind, and percussion students, refining musicianship fundamentals and developing advanced ensemble playing techniques. After-school commitments include concerts, contests, and rehearsals; attendance mandatory. Small per-semester fee to band boosters.

courses.title: Advanced Band - Wind Ensemble
special_notes: Premier performing ensemble of the band program
courses.description: An advanced-level, performance-based ensemble serving as the premier performing group of the band program. Students perfect musicianship fundamentals and develop highly advanced ensemble playing techniques. After-school commitments mandatory; every member should play a high-quality instrument. Small per-semester fee to band boosters.

courses.title: Instrumental Ensemble - Intermediate Percussion
courses.description: A beginner-level, performance-based class for percussion students, learning musicianship fundamentals and developing good ensemble playing techniques. All students must have appropriate mallets and sticks, purchased at their own expense. Small per-semester fee to band boosters.

courses.title: Instrumental Ensemble - Advanced Percussion
courses.description: An advanced-level, performance-based class for percussion students, learning musicianship fundamentals and developing good ensemble playing techniques. All students must have appropriate mallets and sticks, purchased at their own expense. Small per-semester fee to band boosters.

courses.title: Jazz Ensemble - Jazz 2

prerequisites.note: Audition + enrolled in a band class (exceptions possible for guitar/bass/drum set/piano)

courses.description: A beginner-level, performance-based jazz ensemble, learning jazz fundamentals and developing advanced ensemble playing techniques across rock, Latin, and swing styles. Students must be enrolled in another band class, with exceptions possible for guitar, bass guitar, drum set, or piano at instructor discretion. Small per-semester fee to band boosters.

courses.title: Jazz Ensemble - Jazz 1

prerequisites.note: Audition + enrolled in a band class

courses.description: An advanced-level, performance-based jazz ensemble, learning jazz fundamentals and developing advanced ensemble playing techniques across rock, Latin, and swing styles. After-school commitments include concerts and performance opportunities; attendance mandatory. Instrumentation limited to traditional big band instrumentation. Small per-semester fee to band boosters.

courses.title: Dance Choreography - Color Guard Class

prerequisites.note: Color guard participation required; part of marching band

courses.description: Focuses on the development of skills specific to the color guard activity, including music terminology, melodic content and contrast, performance techniques, choreography, costuming and makeup, understanding the correlation between meter/tempo and choreography, and safety practices. Students are required to be part of the marching band.

courses.title: Beginning Chorus - Descants (Treble Voices)
courses.description: An entry-level vocal course for treble voices designed to improve vocal technique and music literacy. Students sing music in two or more parts from various styles and cultures. Academic content, attendance at school performances/ISSMA contests, and rehearsals are mandatory.

courses.title: Beginning Chorus - Vocal Majority (Tenor/Bass Voices)
courses.description: An entry-level vocal course for tenor/bass voices designed to improve vocal technique and music literacy. Students sing music in two or more parts from various styles and cultures. Academic content, attendance at school performances/ISSMA contests, and rehearsals are mandatory.

courses.title: Beginning Chorus - Flight (Treble Voices)

prerequisites.note: Audition (vocal + choreography); show choir, extracurricular fee applies

courses.description: An entry-level concert and competitive show choir course for treble voices designed to improve vocal technique and music literacy, with placement based on a vocal and choreography audition. Functions as both a concert and extracurricular competitive show choir requiring payment; fundraising and financial aid opportunities are available.

courses.title: Intermediate Chorus - Harmonia (Treble Voices)
courses.description: An intermediate-level vocal course for treble voices designed to improve vocal technique and music literacy. Students sing music in three or more parts from various styles and cultures. Academic content, attendance at school performances/ISSMA contests, and rehearsals are mandatory.

courses.title: Intermediate Chorus - Encores (Mixed Voices)

prerequisites.note: Audition (vocal + choreography); show choir, extracurricular fee applies

courses.description: An intermediate-level concert and competitive show choir course for treble and tenor/bass voices, with placement based on a vocal and choreography audition. Functions as both concert and extracurricular competitive show choir with after-school rehearsals and additional performances, requiring payment with fundraising/financial aid options available.

courses.title: Advanced Chorus - Ambassadors (Tenor/Bass Voices)
courses.description: An advanced-level vocal course for tenor/bass voices, with placement based on a vocal audition. Requires payment for extracurricular choir with fundraising and financial aid opportunities available. Students sing music in three or more parts from various styles and cultures.

courses.title: Advanced Chorus - High Voltage (Treble Voices)

prerequisites.note: Audition (vocal + choreography); show choir, extracurricular fee applies

courses.description: An advanced-level ensemble of treble voices working on a wide range of vocal styles from classical concert literature to popular and show choir music, with placement based on vocal and choreography audition. Typically rehearses Tuesdays/Thursdays after school for three hours, with day-long competitions most Saturdays January through March. Requires payment with fundraising/financial aid options available.

courses.title: Advanced Chorus - FC Singers (Mixed Voices)

prerequisites.note: Audition (vocal + choreography); show choir, extracurricular fee applies

courses.description: An advanced-level ensemble of treble and tenor/bass voices performing a wide range of vocal styles from classical concert literature to popular and show choir music, with placement based on vocal and choreography audition. Rehearses Tuesdays/Thursdays after school for three hours with competitions January-March. Requires payment with fundraising/financial aid options available.

courses.title: Advanced Chorus - Accents (Treble Voices)

prerequisites.note: Audition; extracurricular fee applies for travel/competitions

courses.description: An advanced-level ensemble of treble singers working on vocal styles from Renaissance madrigals and motets to modern pop and vocal jazz, with placement based on vocal audition. Requires payment for extracurricular choir including out-of-state competition travel, with fundraising/financial aid options available.

courses.title: Advanced Chorus - Chamber Choir (Mixed Voices)

prerequisites.note: Audition; extracurricular fee applies for travel/competitions

courses.description: A highly select group of treble and tenor/bass singers working on vocal styles from Renaissance madrigals and motets to modern pop and vocal jazz, with placement based on vocal audition. Requires payment for extracurricular choir including out-of-state competition travel, with fundraising/financial aid options available.

courses.title: Beginning Orchestra - Cadet
courses.description: Rooted in the fundamentals and technique of performing in a music ensemble, developing skills and artistry in musical expression. Membership is primarily freshmen recommended by the orchestra director, focusing on ISSMA group III and IV repertoire complemented by music theory fundamentals. Small per-semester fee to orchestra boosters.

courses.title: Beginning Orchestra - Academy
courses.description: Rooted in the fundamentals and technique of performing in a music ensemble, developing skills and artistry in musical expression. Membership is primarily 10th grade and above, recommended by the orchestra director, focusing on ISSMA group III repertoire complemented by music theory fundamentals. Small per-semester fee to orchestra boosters.

courses.title: Intermediate Orchestra - Symphony
courses.description: An intermediate-level orchestra rooted in ensemble performance fundamentals and technique, developing musical expression skills. Membership is primarily freshmen and some sophomores recommended by the orchestra director, focusing on ISSMA group II and III repertoire complemented by music theory fundamentals. Small per-semester fee to orchestra boosters.

courses.title: Advanced Orchestra - Camerata
courses.description: An advanced-level orchestra composed of the most experienced program members, studying and performing top-level string orchestra repertoire from all musical time periods. In winter semester, students rehearse and perform with select wind/percussion players as a Philharmonic Orchestra for ISSMA State Qualifiers. Includes 1-2 after-school rehearsals per week during winter. Small per-semester fee to orchestra boosters.

courses.title: Instrumental Ensemble - Alternative String Orchestra
courses.description: Explores performing styles outside traditional Classical music, including Electrified Strings, Jazz/Pops Orchestra, American/Irish/Scottish Fiddle, Mariachi, and Theater Pit Orchestra, with students exploring improvised solos over chord changes. Performs at ISSMA Jazz Contest and may collaborate with Jazz Bands. Includes after-school rehearsals as needed plus evening/weekend performances. Small per-semester fee to orchestra boosters.

courses.title: Theatre Arts
courses.description: A one-semester survey class in which students primarily develop acting skills through pantomime, monologues, partner scenes, reading scripts, and learning to analyze plays and identify characteristics. Students also explore scenic design and short script creation.

courses.title: Technical Theatre
courses.description: Actively engages students in designing, building, managing, and implementing production aspects, exploring stage technology and making informed judgments about technical production choices. Students develop scenic designs, lighting, costuming, make-up, sound, and stage/house management, understanding how technical theater incorporates all the arts through construction, business, project management, design, and advertising.

courses.title: Advanced Technical Theatre
courses.description: Actively leads students in the process of design, building, managing, programming, drafting, and implementing technical aspects of a production. Students create original designs and plans for scenic design, lighting, costuming, make-up, sound, and stage/house management, assessing stage technology's impact on their designs and investigating careers in technical theatre.

courses.title: Advanced Acting
courses.description: Students research, create, and perform characters through script analysis, observation, collaboration, and rehearsal, incorporating elements of theatre history, culture, analysis, response, creative process, and integrated studies.

courses.title: Special Topics - Directing
courses.description: An introductory course in directing for the stage, covering the role and function of the director in contemporary theater, basic tools of proscenium blocking and staging (composition, picturization, movement, gesture), structural script analysis, and basic actor coaching techniques.

courses.title: Special Topics - Playwriting
courses.description: Students write various short scripts to the best of their ability plus one final One Act play, open to students with and without a theater background. Involves preliminary exercises, preparation of a scenario, development of material through individual conferences, and reading/discussion of student work in seminar sessions.

courses.title: Special Topics - Group Voice Class

prerequisites.note: Recommended: Theatre Arts + a Choir class

special_notes: Required performance element must be completed to pass
courses.description: An exploration of the physiology and acoustics of the human singing voice in a group setting, teaching vocal techniques to establish a healthy foundation for solo performance. Repertoire is chosen from the Broadway canon to train students as singing-actors, culminating in a public cabaret performance. A required performance element must be completed to pass.

courses.title: Musical Theater

prerequisites.note: Recommended: Theatre Arts + a Choir class

special_notes: Required performance element must be completed to pass
courses.description: Trains the integration of dance and voice techniques required by Musical Theatre and Show Choir performance genres, teaching students to sing and dance simultaneously while performing efficiently and expressively. Taught by a theatre teacher with an additional dance instructor, with repertoire chosen from the Broadway canon, culminating in a public cabaret performance. A required performance element must be completed to pass.

courses.title: Theatre Production
courses.description: A year-long class in which students take on responsibilities associated with rehearsing and presenting a fully mounted theatre production, reading and analyzing plays, conceiving a design (set, lighting, sound, costumes, make-up, house management, advertising), rehearsing and performing roles, and directing or assisting direction. Students compete in regional and state thespian competitions, requiring after-school time, fees, and travel expenses.

courses.title: Theatre Appreciation Dual Credit
courses.description: Develops understanding, appreciation, and critical perceptions of the theatrical event, approaching theatre as an art form, entertainment medium, and vehicle for self-expression. Emphasis is on the history of theatre, acting, directing, playwriting, theatre technology, costume design, scenic design, and lighting design, with active participation in these processes plus attendance at theatrical events.

courses.title: Music Theory & Composition
courses.description: An elective course for members of performing arts ensembles and other students who want to understand music construction and function, distilling and analyzing melody, harmony, harmonic function, rhythm, form, and texture. Includes aural skills such as dictating played music and singing at sight using solfege syllables. Recommended for students wishing to continue to AP Music Theory who aren't currently in an advanced performing ensemble.

courses.title: AP Music Theory & Composition
courses.description: The study of the structure of constructed music, looking for patterns and structures in composers' works across or within genres, styles, or historical periods, distilling and analyzing melody, harmony, harmonic function, rhythm, form, and texture. Includes aural skills such as dictating played music and reading music at sight. Recommended (not required) to have completed at least one year of an FC advanced ensemble. Students take the AP Music Theory exam in May.

courses.title: Music Appreciation Dual Credit

dual_credit.note: Checked directly against the Crosswalk document - unlike Theatre Appreciation's row, this course's row does not show GPA/test-score eligibility columns filled in. May have no formal gate, or the data may simply be missing from the source spreadsheet. Left as an open question rather than assumed.

courses.description: A study of music from early civilizations to the twenty-first century, focusing on musical periods of history and the composers and music therein. Requires reading and studying like a history course; previous musical experience is helpful but not required. Addresses singing alone and with others, reading and notating music, evaluating and describing music, and understanding music's relationship to other arts, history, and culture, with required written assignments and presentations.
